title: Clo Zfab Kit Launch Event Hong Kong
description:
We launched the new CLO zFab Kit in Hong Kong providing hands on live demo and presentations. Our Maximizing Value through Collaborative Data-Driven Solutions presentation emphasized the importance of collaboration among brands, vendors, and suppliers. 

Powered by CLO AI, the CLO zFab Kit empowers brands, vendors, and suppliers to create accurate, high-quality digital representations of fabrics with ease and precision. Learn more: https://zfabkit.clo3d.com/

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/ar...

summary: # Clo Zfab Kit Launch Event Hong Kong ## Introduction to the Z-Fab Kit How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? We were very much waiting for the Z-Fab Kit. The fabric digitization part, as well as the virtual fitting capabilities it offers, are particularly exciting. The integration of AI, especially how Chloé is helping us explore its potential, adds another layer of excitement. ## First Impressions When I first encountered the Z-Fab Kit, the explanation provided was very detailed. I was very patient during the demo, and the feedback from my colleagues was overwhelmingly positive. ## Improvements Over the Old Set Comparing the Z-Fab Kit to the old set reveals significant improvements. The previous system was primarily manual, requiring a lot of handwork. In contrast, the new set has successfully eliminated the need for manual operations. ### Automation and Ease of Use The software associated with the Z-Fab Kit is highly automated, featuring extensive auto-generation and tiling capabilities. This has resulted in a much easier process for our team. My colleagues are very happy with these enhancements and are looking forward to utilizing the kit. ## Key Takeaways One of the biggest takeaways from the presentation is that AI has become a significant topic in the industry, but many are unsure about where to start. I appreciated that the presentation addressed not only the upcoming features but also how to initiate the setup within the company and implement it into our workflow. ## Fabric Scanner Insights The fabric scanner aspect of the Z-Fab Kit is particularly interesting for us, as we continually focus on building our digital material libraries. Having a more innovative tool that enhances accuracy and usability is crucial for our ongoing projects. Thank you very much.
